$comment: Working examples shown by PagePreview's `example` entry, exported as Markdown and copied by the registry. Each example is a folder: `index.html` is the markup a page holds, `main.js` an ES module whose `mount(root)` starts it and returns the function that stops it, and `files` anything else it imports, such as its data. `contracts` names the Master UI contracts it uses and `dependencies` the packages it needs beyond @master/css and @master/ui, at the exact versions the site installs. Third-party engines are the site's dependencies only, never @master/ui's.

table-view.title: Table view
table-view.description: Search, filter, sort, select and page through a workspace's projects, people and files, all on local data.

filter-bar.title: Filter bar
filter-bar.description: Conditions on a field, an operator and a value: staged, applied, shown as chips and counted.

activity-feed.title: Activity feed
activity-feed.description: What happened to a project, grouped by time, with who did it and what it touched.

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.description: A conversation on local data: grouped messages, attachments, delivery state, reactions and a composer.

schedule-view.title: Schedule view
schedule-view.description: A team calendar by the day, the week, the month or as an agenda, with each event's details.

rich-text.title: Rich text editor
rich-text.description: TipTap in the editor frame: a fixed toolbar, the document as JSON, and its states.

chart-dashboard.title: Chart dashboard
chart-dashboard.description: Figures, stacked areas, a donut and a ranking under one choice of period, each chart written again from the period's numbers.

image-adjustments.title: Image adjustments
image-adjustments.description: Choose a local picture, crop and turn it, and set its brightness, contrast and saturation; hand on the original file and the adjustments as data.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: An inquiry form beside the ways to reach the team: native validation, errors after the reader has tried, and the result in place.

file-upload.title: File upload
file-upload.description: Choose or drop files, then follow each one: waiting, uploading, done, failed or refused, with cancel, retry and remove. The progress is a timer.

password-reset-request.title: Password reset: ask for a link
password-reset-request.description: One email field and its result, which reads the same whether or not an account has the address.

password-reset-new.title: Password reset: choose a new password
password-reset-new.description: A new password and its confirmation, held to each other by the browser, and the result once they agree.

notification-inbox.title: Notification inbox
notification-inbox.description: Six notifications in a page: all or unread, read one by one or all at once, and what shows when nothing is unread.

results.title: Results
results.description: Twelve resources to search, narrow by type, sort and page through, as cards or a list.

multi-step.title: Multi-step task
multi-step.description: A workspace set up in three steps on local memory: details, preferences and a review.

board.title: Board
board.description: Twelve cards in four columns, moved by the kanban behavior, with counts read from the arrangement.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: A document being edited between its navigation and its properties, in a shell that is the viewport.
